Title: "Texting Thumb" or "Mommy Thumb"? What's Really Behind Wrist Pain

Description:
Doctors have nicknames for thumb-side wrist pain: "texting thumb" and "mommy thumb." Both come from the same two tendons getting irritated as they run through a narrow tunnel at the base of your thumb. Three everyday habits are usually behind it: scrolling your phone one-handed with just your thumb, a repeated gripping motion from racquet sports or weightlifting, and lifting a baby with your thumb propping up the weight.

Hold your phone with both hands, warm up before gripping activities, and support a baby's weight with your whole palm and forearm. See a doctor if the pain lasts more than two weeks or swelling gets heavy.
